item.title: Oh no Dolly Parton died. She gave one book a month to each …
item.author: Mia Farrow (@miafarrow.bsky.social)
item.description:
Oh no
Dolly Parton died.
She gave one book a month to each enrolled child from birth until they enter kindergarten. Her Imagination Library gave books each month to 850,000 children in US, Canada, tUK, Australia, Ireland.In February 2018, she donated her 100 millionth free book.
Thank you Dolly
